name: How long does it take to get a pool demolition permit in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get a pool demolition permit in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?
mainEntity.text: How long does it take to get a pool demolition permit in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit timing depends on the jurisdiction and how complicated the project is. A straightforward pool demo can be relatively fast if the city only needs basic permit information. But if the project includes plan review, plot plans, utility disconnects, grading, or a soils report, the timeline can extend significantly. Pasadena-style requirements are more document-heavy than a simple online application, and any city can slow down if the site is near a boundary, retaining wall, or future building area. The biggest time saver is submitting a complete package the first time. Homeowners should ask the contractor what documents are required, whether a plan check is needed, and whether final approval depends on a soils engineer or separate inspection scheduling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timing varies by city and scope. Simple demolition permits may move faster, while projects needing plan review, utility coordination, grading, or soils engineering can take longer. The most common delay is missing documents, not the demolition work itself.
